variables.name: ANON_KEY
variables.description: Public anon JWT. References the auth service's ANON_KEY so client-side storage calls are authenticated.

variables.name: SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
variables.description: Server-side full-access key. References the auth service's SERVICE_ROLE_KEY for admin storage operations.

variables.name: PGRST_JWT_SECRET
variables.description: HS256 secret for JWT verification. References the auth service's JWT_SECRET.

variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.description: PostgreSQL connection string for storage API. Uses private networking and references postgres service vars.

variables.name: FILE_SIZE_LIMIT
variables.description: Maximum file upload size in bytes (52428800 = 50 MB). Increase for larger file support.

variables.name: STORAGE_BACKEND
variables.description: Storage backend type. 's3' uses MinIO (S3-compatible). 'file' uses local disk (not recommended for Railway).

variables.name: FILE_STORAGE_BACKEND_PATH
variables.description: Temporary path for file processing before upload to S3.

variables.name: GLOBAL_S3_BUCKET
variables.description: Default S3 bucket name. The bucket is created automatically on first storage API startup if it does not exist.

variables.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
variables.description: S3 access key. References the minio service's MINIO_ROOT_USER.

variables.name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
variables.description: S3 secret key. References the minio service's MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD (auto-generated).

variables.name: AWS_REGION
variables.description: AWS region for S3. MinIO ignores this but the storage API requires a non-empty value.

variables.name: REGION
variables.description: Region for the storage API. Must match AWS_REGION.

variables.name: AWS_S3_ENDPOINT
variables.description: S3 endpoint URL. Points to MinIO via Railway private networking on port 9000.

variables.name: AWS_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE
variables.description: Force path-style S3 addressing. Required for MinIO compatibility (not using virtual-host-style).

variables.name: ENABLE_IMAGE_TRANSFORMATION
variables.description: Enable image transformation (resize, optimize). Set to false to save RAM on Railway.
